method: Isolated PhysX scene, fixed 0.005 second steps matching the project, actual prefab rigidbodies, wheel colliders and compound colliders.
scope: Unloaded driving physics. Does not certify load capacity, lifting, pallet interaction, tire behavior on every surface, or a published player.

checks.name: settles on all four tires
checks.expectation: An unloaded stationary truck settles within 0.2 m of authored floor height with four supported wheels, less than 0.15 m/s motion and less than 3 degrees lean.

measurements.name: main body center of mass height

checks.name: forward acceleration
checks.expectation: Full throttle moves the actual rigidbody at least 8 m in 7 seconds, reaches 2 to 5.5 m/s, and stays straight and upright on level concrete.

checks.name: service braking
checks.expectation: Braking from driving speed stops within 4 seconds and 7 m, while preserving a nonzero physical stopping distance.

checks.name: inching decelerates physically
checks.expectation: The inching pedal slows a moving truck to below 1.2 m/s without instantly replacing its velocity.

checks.name: reverse
checks.expectation: Reverse produces at least 3 m of backward travel and a final backward speed between 0.8 and 3.8 m/s.

checks.name: right rear steering
checks.expectation: A right input at low speed turns the nose right. Front wheels remain unsteered and rear wheels steer left.

measurements.name: front axle travel toward requested side

checks.name: left rear steering
checks.expectation: A left input at low speed turns the nose left. Front wheels remain unsteered and rear wheels steer right.

measurements.name: front axle travel toward requested side

checks.name: both tire tracks climb
checks.expectation: Both pairs of tires climb a 0.8 m high, 6 m long ramp, raising the body by at least 0.35 m with visible pitch and no rollover.

checks.name: one sided ramp rollover
checks.expectation: Reversing one side onto the playable 1.05 m high, 3.8 m long ramp produces a physical roll past 90 degrees without injected roll forces or scripted rotation. The lowered mast correctly blocks a forward approach.

checks.name: airborne gravity and free rotation
checks.expectation: An airborne truck falls under gravity and retains angular momentum, with no upright lock.

checks.name: solid obstacle collision
checks.expectation: The truck stops against a 3 m high wall and its body never passes through it.

checks.name: pause clears driving input
checks.expectation: Deactivation zeros wheel motor torque immediately. Reactivation without a fresh input leaves torque at zero.

measurements.name: motor torque after resume without fresh input

checks.name: steady forward tire rolling
checks.expectation: During two seconds of steady forward travel above 1 m/s, each tire stays grounded for at least 95 percent of samples, has less than 15 percent P95 rolling error and less than 10 percent integrated rolling-distance error.

measurements.name: minimum requested-direction speed in sampling window

checks.name: steady reverse tire rolling
checks.expectation: During two seconds of steady reverse travel above 1 m/s, each tire stays grounded for at least 95 percent of samples, has less than 15 percent P95 rolling error and less than 10 percent integrated rolling-distance error.

measurements.name: minimum requested-direction speed in sampling window

checks.name: sustained right rear tire grip
checks.expectation: A sustained powered right circle near 1.5 m/s turns the nose right, with each rear tire's lateral contact speed below 0.15 m/s RMS and 0.25 m/s P95.

measurements.name: accumulated nose turn toward requested side

checks.name: sustained left rear tire grip
checks.expectation: A sustained powered left circle near 1.5 m/s turns the nose left, with each rear tire's lateral contact speed below 0.15 m/s RMS and 0.25 m/s P95.

measurements.name: accumulated nose turn toward requested side

checks.name: parking brake tire hold
checks.expectation: After driving and stopping, 30 seconds parked produces less than 0.05 m drift, less than 0.02 m/s P95 body speed and less than 0.02 m/s P95 tread speed on each rear tire.

checks.name: uphill slope parking and release
checks.expectation: Facing uphill on an 8 degree slope, the parked truck holds for 10 seconds within 0.05 m, then rolls more than 0.25 m downhill within 3 seconds after release into neutral.

measurements.name: solid collider penetration into slope after settling
